grade_rule: A run passes a question when the FIRST folder and table Claude names, chosen from the index and without listing the bucket first, equals one of expected_locations (or an accept_also entry). Schwab questions name no master: any master folder of expected_locations whose table is the expected_table passes. A folder ending in _s2 is a different source and fails unless the question says so. Naming the right folder after a bucket listing fails FWD-26 even when correct.

items.question: What does each Schwab account hold right now, one line per security?
items.why: dim_position is one row per account x cusip x long-or-short side per business date

items.question: What is the total market value and cash picture of each Schwab account on a given day?
items.why: dim_balance is one row per account per business date with long, short and net market value

items.question: Show me the individual trades and cash movements that hit Schwab accounts.
items.why: dim_transaction is one row per transaction line per business date

items.question: Which Schwab lots were sold and closed out on a given day?
items.why: fact_rld is one row per realized lot closed on the business date

items.question: What positions do the Inflection clients hold in Orion?

accept_also.reason: the catalog states fact_assets has identical content to fact_positions

items.why: fact_positions is one row per Orion asset per account per snapshot date

items.question: Show me the buys, sells and fees on Inflection accounts in Orion.
items.why: fact_transactions is one row per Orion transaction id, each partition a full cumulative snapshot

items.question: Which advisor or rep placed a given Orion trade?
items.why: opal-data-inf silver/transactions is the only Orion table that carries rep and advisor attribution (CRO brief section 6)

items.question: How have the Inflection households performed over time, by household and date?
items.why: fact_performance is one row per Orion client (household) per value date

items.question: What does each Cottonwood account hold, position by position?
items.why: fact_holdings is one row per account x asset per report date; the fact_holdings_s2 folder is a second source, not this answer

items.question: What portfolio or allocation lines does each Cottonwood account carry?
items.why: fact_allocations is one row per account x relationship or portfolio line of the allocation export; fact_allocations_s2 is a second source

items.question: Which strategy is each Cottonwood account assigned to?
items.why: fact_model_assignment is one row per rebalancer account per pull date with its assigned strategy

items.question: What open tax lots, with their unrealized gain or loss, do the Cottonwood accounts have?
items.why: fact_unrealized is one row per open tax lot per report date; fact_unrealized_s2 is a second source
